monitors.name: Web app
monitors.description: Public dashboard; the API needs a login.
monitors.runbook: Hosted on a PaaS. Logs: the platform's deployment logs. The API calls an upstream service on the home network.

knownIssues.cause: The app can't reach its upstream service. Usually the home router's port forward changed or the upstream host is down.
knownIssues.fix:
1. Check the upstream host is up.
2. Check the router port forward still exists.
3. Redeploy the app if its upstream URL changed.

knownIssues.match: got (502|503|404).*(Application failed to respond|Application not found)
knownIssues.cause: The hosting platform can't reach the app; it crashed or the service was removed.

action.label: Redeploy through the platform's deploy hook

monitors.name: Nightly job
monitors.description: A cron job on a home server that reports when it finishes.
monitors.runbook: Runs from the scheduler on the home server. Log: ~/Library/Logs/nightly-job.log

knownIssues.cause: The job never reported. The server was asleep or off, or the scheduler entry was unloaded.
knownIssues.fix:
1. Check the server is up.
2. Check the scheduler entry is loaded.
3. Read the job log.

monitors.name: Archive disk
monitors.description: SMART attributes reported nightly by a home server.
monitors.runbook: External USB SSD. Only read SMART when the disk is idle.
